s: Din hamparesh bayyam vehayyotze beshayyara ubo k"g seipim: hayyotze mibbeto (a) leir acheret qodem happesach vedato shello lachazor lebeto ad leachar happesach, o sheddato shello yachazor lebeto leolam, veeno manniach bebeto adam sheyyukal libdoq keshemmaggia zeman habbediqa, im hu yotze betok sheloshim yom lipne happesach, kevan sheshshoalin vedoreshin behilkot pesach — chal alayv lehizzaher uleqayyem kol mitzvot chakamim, lepikak chayyab hu libdoq kol chadarayv ballayla shellipne yetziato leor hanner. Veim shakach velo badaq ballayla — yibdoq bayyom leor hanner. Umiyyad achar habbediqa yebattel kol hechametz sheen yadua lo shello metzao bibdiqato, ketaqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu lebattel tekep umiyyad achar habbediqa, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tl"d ayyen sham. Veal bediqa zo lo yebarek "al biur chametz" kederek shemmebarekin al bediqat lel y"d, kevan sheenah bazzeman haiqqari shettiqqenu lah chakamim, dehaynu lel y"d (umimmennu vaelak ad sop haregel, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"h). Ubarega sheqqodem yetziato chayyab hu lehotzi hechametz mikkol gebulo shebbeir zo shehu yotze mimmenna. Veim yesh lo banim qetannim bebeto vetzarik hu lehnniach lahem chametz leekol — yotziennu mibbeto lebet adam acher, vesham yenniach chametz leekol, veyisgor et beto veet kol chadarayv habbeduqim, shello yaknis shum adam od chametz lesham, sheim lo yaaseh ken en bediqato shava kelum:

Abal im hu manniach bebeto ishto ubanayv ubene beto haggedolim sheyyesh bahen daat vikolet libdoq kekol mishpete habbediqa shennitbaaru besiman tl"g — en tzarik libdoq kelum qodem yetziato, ella yetzavveh leechad mehem (d) vimanneh oto sheyyibdoq vibattel hechametz keshemmaggia hazzeman, sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto*[veayyen besiman tl"b shellekattechilla tob lehizzaher shello laasot ishsha shaliach libdiqat chametz. Veayyen besiman tl"d shennakon haddabar sheyyebattel gam hu beatzmo bammaqom shehu sham keshemmaggia zeman habbittul, ayyen sham]::

Veim shakach veyatza mibbeto velo tzivva leechad mehem sheyyibdoq — ap al pi ken chayyabim hem libdoq apillu otan chadarim shello hiknisu bahem chametz achar yetziat baal habbayit mibbeto, vaapillu otan hachadarim shehem lo yikkanesu bahem bepesach kelal velo yabou leekol mehechametz shebbetokam, dekevan shebbaal habbayit nitchayyeb bibdiqat kol hachadarim hatztzerikin bediqa — chayyabin hannisharim bebeto lepotro mechiyyubo, shekkol yisrael arebim zeh bazeh:

Veachar habbediqa tob sheyyebattelu gam ken, ap al pi sheen bittulam moil kol kak kevan sheen hechametz shellahem vehabbaal habbayit lo tzivva lahem lebattel velo asa otam sheluchim lekak,* mikkol maqom yesh lachosh shemma yishkach baal habbayit lebattel bammaqom shehu, kevan sheeno oseq sham bibdiqat hechametz ubebiur hu qarob leshikcha velo yebuttal hechametz kelal, umutab sheyyebattelu hem mimmah shello yebuttal hechametz kelal. Verauy lehazhiram al kak, kede latzet yede sapeq[veap al gab demissetama nicha leh, mikkol maqom tzarik hu legallot dato beperush, veim lav — en bittul hashshaliach moil kelum, kemo shennitbaer besop siman tl"d ayyen sham]:.

Veim yotze qodem l' yom, apillu eno manniach bebeto mi sheyyibdoq, im dato shello lachazor lebeto ad leachar happesach — en tzarik libdoq kelum qodem yetziato, sheadayin lo chal alayv lehizzaher betzorke happesach, ukesheyyaggia ereb pesach yebattel kol hechametz sheyyesh lo bekol gebulo. Velo yebarek al bittul zeh, lepi sheiqqar habbittul hu balleb, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"d, veen mebarekin al debarim shebballeb:

Bammeh debarim amurim? (H) beotan chadarim shechiyyub habbediqa bahem belel y"d eno ella middibre soperim, shemmin hattora en chosheshin kelal shemma yesh sham kezayit chametz, kegon otzerot yayin veshemen shemmistappeq mehen lasseuda, vekayyotze bahen, ushear kol hachadarim sheen regilut lehishtammesh bahen chametz bitdirut, veen tzarik lebodqan kelal min hattora apillu lo bittel chametzo, ella shechakamim tiqqenu libdoq bahen, vehen ameru shehayyotze mibbeto qodem l' yom lo chala alayv adayin taqqanatan, umaamidin oto al din tora. Abal habbayit vachadarayv shergilut leekol bahen chametz kol hashshana, vei epshar shello nitparer venapal sham perur chametz sheyyesh bo kezayit, vahare hu chayyab lebodqan ulebaer hechametz shebbetokam min hattora kesheyyaggia chatzot yom y"d, shenneemar "ak bayyom harishon tashbitu vego'", vezeh sheyyotze mibbeto velo yachazor qodem happesach, shekkesheyyaggia chatzot yom y"d lo yukal libdoq ulebaer hechametz shebbebeto — hare beshaa zo shehu maplig mibbeto chal alayv mitzvat "tashbitu" min hattora, shemmin hattora en chilluq ben tok sheloshim yom leqodem sheloshim, vekevan shechal alayv mitzvat "tashbitu" — chal alayv gezerat chakamim sheggazeru shehashbata zo enah mitqayyemet bebittul vehepqer bilbad, ella ad shemmotzi et hechametz mibbeto umikkol gebulo. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheapillu yesh vadday chametz harbeh meod betok beto eno zaquq lo im yotze qodem l' yom, veday lo bebittul sheyyebattel bammaqom sheyyihyeh sham kesheyyaggia ereb pesach. Vegam bittul zeh eno ella middibre soperim, shemmin hattora eno ober kelal be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" al hechametz shebbebeto, kevan sheen matzuy etzlo bimot happesach, vehattora omra "lo yimmatze", mi shemmatzuy beyadeka, vahare chametz zeh nechshab etzlo kechametz shennapal alayv mappolet, ukedibre haomerim shehu kimboar min haolam legamre veen tzarik apillu lebattelo middibre tora ella middibre soperim, shemmin hattora eno ober alayv kelal be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", ap chametz zeh sheeno matzuy etzlo bimot happesach hare hu etzlo kimboar. Ella shechakamim gazeru sheen yotze yede chobato lekattechilla bebiur kazeh, ella chayyab hu lebaaro biur gamur kedino qodem sheyyatza mibbeto im yotze betok l' yom, abal qodem l' yom lo chala alayv gezerat chakamim, umin hattora yakol hu lebaaro lekattechilla bebiur kazeh, dehaynu bemah shemmaplig mibbeto shekkesheyyaggia happesach lo yehe hechametz matzuy etzlo veyihyeh etzlo kimboar. Uleinyan halaka yesh lachosh lekattechilla lassebara harishona. Abal bediabad, kegon sheshshakach veyatza mibbeto velo bier hechametz mimmennu venizkar badderek vetorach lo lachazor ulebaer — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona, veen tzarik lachazor lebeto lebaer im yatza qodem sheloshim yom:

Abal im shakach veyatza mibbeto tok l' yom velo bier hechametz shebbo venizkar keshehiplig badderek mahalak kamma yamim, sheyyesh torach gadol vehepsed merubbeh lachazor lebeto, ap al pi ken im yadua lo beberur sheyyesh kebetza chametz bebeto — chayyab hu lachazor lebeto o lishloach shaliach lebeto sheyyebaer hechametz mimmennu, ella im ken holek lidbar mitzva, kemo sheyyitbaer besop siman tm"d, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Vekol zeh kesheen dato lachazor ad leachar happesach, o sheen dato lachazor leolam, abal im dato lachazor betok happesach, apillu yotze mibbeto bitchillat hashshana, dehaynu achar pesach heabar — chayyab hu libdoq qodem yetziato et kol hachadarim hatztzerikim bediqa belel y"d, apillu otan sheenan tzerikim bediqa ella middibre soperim, shehare yachazor lebeto betok happesach, veyesh lachosh shemma yishkach veyokal mehechametz sheyyimtza bebeto ubishar chadarayv shedderek lehaknis bahem chametz lipamim:

Abal im dato lachazor qodem happesach, apillu im yesh vadday chametz harbeh meod betok beto — en tzarik lebaaro qodem yetziato, apillu yotze betok sheloshim yom, shehare yakol lebaaro kesheyyachazor lebeto*[veim leachar sheyyatza mibbeto vehiplig badderek nimlak shello yachazor lebeto qodem happesach ella betok happesach — en tzarik lishloach shaliach lebeto sheyyebaer hechametz shebbo, apillu im yesh sham vadday chametz harbeh, ella day lo bebittul sheyyebattel bammaqom sheyyihyeh sham kesheyyaggia ereb pesach, kevan sheyyatza mibbeto behetter, sheaz haya bedato lachazor qodem happesach]:. Veen chosheshin shemma yabo lebeto beereb pesach samuk lachasheka velo yihyeh lo penay lebaer qodem yom tob, lepi shemmin hassetam kevan sheddato lachazor qodem happesach, bevadday yemaher veyachish chazarato veyaqdim labo qodem y"d, kede sheyyukal libdoq chadarayv belel y"d ketaqqanat chakamim ulebaer hechametz bizman habbiur.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyotze ladderek, abal hamparesh min hayyabbasha layyam, vehayyotze beshayyara laleket lemerchaqqim, apillu yotze mibbeto mittechillat hashshana vedato lachazor zeman rab qodem happesach — chayyab hu libdoq qodem yetziato kol chadarayv, apillu otan sheenan tzerikim bediqa ella middibre soperim, lepi shehammaprishim bayyam vehayyotzeim beshayyara lemerchaqqim regilut hu lehizdammen lahem kamma sibbot veinyanim badderek, veyesh lachosh shemma yishtaheh harbeh badderek velo yachazor lebeto ad ereb pesach samuk lachasheka, velo yihyeh lo penay lebaer qodem yom tob. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheddin hamparesh layyam vehayyotze beshayyara kedin shear yotze ladderek. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq, kegon sheshshakach veyatza mibbeto velo bier hechametz mimmennu venizkar leachar shehiplig mibbeto vei epshar lo liprosh min hassepina o min hashshayyara:

Kol maqom shehu chayyab libdoq qodem yetziato veshakach o abar veyatza mibbeto velo badaq, ap al pi shehu chayyab lebattel bammaqom sheyyihyeh sham kesheyyaggia ereb pesach, veyesh omerim shebbittul zeh hu min hattora kemo shennitbaer lemala — ap al pi ken lo yebarek al bittul zeh, mittaam shennitbaer lemala:

Kol cheder hatztzarik bediqa belel y"d, ben shetztzarik bediqa min hattora, ben sheeno tzarik ella middibre soperim, verotzeh laasoto otzar (perush sherotzeh leetzor betoko perot o etzim o shear debarim umechamat zeh lo yukal lebodqo kedino belel y"d), im dato lepannot haotzar betok happesach — chayyab libdoq zeh hacheder mittechilla ballayla leor hanner veachar kak maknis letoko otzaro, apillu hu techillat hashshana, dehaynu miyyad achar pesach heabar. Veim abar o shakach vehiknis otzar letoko qodem shebbedaqo — chayyab hu lepannot haotzar velibdoq tachtayv miyyad shennizkar, apillu yesh baddabar torach gadol vechesron kis:

Abal im dato lepannot haotzar qodem happesach, apillu yesh becheder zeh vadday chametz harbeh — eno zaquq lo, umuttar lo lehanniach haotzar alayv apillu hu tok l' yom lipne happesach, ukesheyyaggia lel y"d yepanneh veyibdoq tachtayv. Veyesh omerim sheapillu im dato lepannoto qodem happesach — chayyab lebodqo mittechilla, apillu hu techillat hashshana, vaapillu hu cheder sheeno tzarik bediqa ella middibre soperim, lepi shechasheshu chakamim shemma yatchil lepannoto qodem lel y"d velo yigmor lepannoto, ella yishshaer mimmennu pachot miggobah g' tepachim mekusseh al hechametz (sheim haya nishar alayv gobah g' tepachim haya kimboar legamre, kemo chametz shennopla alayv mappolet gaboah g' tepachim, ukemo shennitbaer), veachar kak kesheyyaggia lel y"d yishkach al hechametz shettachat haotzar, kevan shehu mekusseh min haayin velo yitten el libbo lehotzio mishsham. Veap shebbittelo — hare ober al taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu sheen bittul vehepqer moil kelum. Uleinyan halaka yesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona, ella im ken yesh hepsed merubbeh, kegon shekkebar hiknis otzaro letoko qodem shebbier hechametz mimmennu veyesh chesron kis lepannoto miyyad velachazor ulehakniso, sheaz yesh lismok al sebara harishona:

Veim dato shello lepannot haotzar ad leachar happesach, im hu betok l' yom lipne happesach, kevan shechal alayv leqayyem taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu biglal happesach — chayyab hu libdoq zeh hacheder mittechillat hallayla leor hanner, veachar kak yaknis otzaro letoko. Veim hu miqqodem l' yom — en tzarik lebodqo mittechilla, ella day lo bebittul sheyyebattel kol chametzo belel y"d:

Vaapillu im hu cheder hatztzarik bediqa min hattora, ubedabar shehu min hattora en lechalleq ben tok l' yom leqodem l' yom kemo shennitbaer lemala ayyen sham, mikkol maqom kevan shehu oseh otzar al hechametz shebbecheder zeh — hare chametz zeh shettachat haotzar domeh lechametz shennopla alayv mappolet shehu kimboar legamre min hattora, vaapillu lebattelo en tzarik ella middibre soperim kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g. Ella shehachakamim gazeru shellekattechilla en lebaaro bebiur kazeh, ella im ken nopla alayv mappolet meeleha, abal en lehappil alayv mappolet bayyadayim velo leetzor alayv otzar tok l' yom ap al pi shemmebattel umapqir zeh hechametz bepiv ubelibbo, abal qodem l' yom lo chala alayv gezera zo. Uledibre haomer shechametz shennopla alayv mappolet eno kimboar min haolam legamre, veim lo bittelo ad shehiggia chatzot yom y"d hare hu chayyab min hattora lepaqqeach haggal ulehotzio ulebaaro min haolam legamre kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g, im ken chametz zeh shettachat haotzar shello yukal lebaaro beyom y"d mechamat haotzar shealayv sheen dato lepannoto qodem happesach — hare akshav beshaa shemmaknis alayv haotzar chala alayv chobat biuro becheder zeh min hattora ap al pi shehu qodem l' yom, vechal alayv gam ken gezerat chakamim sheggazeru al biur haamur battora sheen mitqayyem al yede bittul vehepqer bilbad ella bebiur mammash, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Uleinyan halaka yesh lehachamir lekattechilla kassebara haacharona. Abal bediabad shekkebar hiknis otzaro lesham, apillu yesh tachtayv vadday chametz harbeh — en tzarik lepannoto velibdoq tachtayv, ella mebattel vedayyo, shelleachar bittul hechametz en tzarik lebaaro ella middibre soperim, ubedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel kassebara harishona:

Abal im abar o shakach vehiknis otzaro lesham tok l' yom, apillu en sham vadday chametz, vehu cheder sheen tzarik bediqa ella middibre soperim, ap al pi ken chayyab lepannot haotzar velibdoq tachtayv miyyad keshennizkar:

Veim atzar vehiknis labbor chittim sheenam mechummatzot veachar kak mechamat lachut habbor nitchammetzu hachittim shebbeqarqait habbor veshebbeqirotayv, ap al pi sheatzaran babbor betok l' yom — en tzarik lepannot habbor belel y"d lehotzi hachittim hamchummatzot shebbetoko, ella day lo bebittul, dekevan shebbeshaa sheasa otzar zeh asa behetter shello haya sham adayin chametz — hare dino keillu asa qodem l' yom, sheen tzarik lepannot haotzar lebaer hechametz shettachtayv apillu yesh sham vadday chametz, kemo shennitbaer:

Veim beshaa sheatzaran babbor hayu kebar chittim mechummatzot beotzar zeh atzmo beemtzaito, ella sheyyesh alehem chittim tobim begobah g' tepachim (shehu shiur gobah hammappolet shennopla al chametz shehu kimboar kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g), im naasa otzar zeh betok l' yom — chayyab lehotzio mishsham velibror hechametz mittoko, apillu eno chametz barur ella sepeq chametz. Veim naasa qodem l' yom — eno zaquq lo keshemmaggia happesach, apillu yesh sham vadday chametz harbeh, ella mebattelo vedayyo. Ukeshehu mepanneh et habbor leachar happesach umotze chittim beqarqaito — asurot bahanaa, vechayyab lebaaro kedin chametz sheabar alayv happesach. Veenan domot lechametz shennopla alayv mappolet shelleachar happesach hu muttar apillu baakila, lepi shehammappolet beshaa shennopla al hechametz lo haya bedato lepannotah ulepaqqechah achar happesach, ella meelayv nimtza hechametz leachar happesach, lepikak en lanu leqonso uleosro, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g ayyen sham hattaam, abal chittim hallalu beshaa shehiknis haotzar labbor haya bedato lizkot bahem leachar happesach kesheyyepanneh et haotzar (im hayinu mattirin lo lehanot mehen leachar happesach), vahare zeh domeh limbaer et hechametz umekavven lachazor velizkot bo achar happesach, sheen zeh biur gamur kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h, lepikak aseru chakamim lehanot mehen leachar happesach:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmatza chittim mebuqqaot, az asur lo lehanot mechittim hallalu shemmatza. Veken im yadua lo beberur sheyyesh bebor zeh chittim mechummatzot chimmutz gamur, azay asur lo limkor kelum min haotzar apillu lenokri ad sheyyibror mimmennu hachittim hamchummatzot. Abal min hassetam, sheen yadua lo beberur sheyyesh chittim mechummatzot chimmutz gamur — muttar lo liqqach chittim min haotzar velimkor apillu leyisrael, veeno choshesh shemma yesh betokan chittim mebuqqaot, sheap im nitbaqqeu miqtzatan qarob haddabar lomar sheen zeh chimmutz ella ippeshut vehepsed, shekken derek hachittim shebbeqarqait habbor veshebbeqirotayv lehitbaqqea mechamat ippush vehepsed, veeno chametz kelal, vegam yesh litlot shelleachar happesach nitchammetzu, vekol sepeq chametz sheabar alayv happesach muttar bahanaa, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"ch.*[Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar liqqach chittim min haotzar uletochnan uleoklam. Vaapillu im raa bahem chittim mechummatzot chimmutz gamur — en tzarik lehasir qodem hattechina, sheal yede hattechina mitareb kol haqqemach veniblal yapeh qemach hechametz betok shear haqqemach umitbattel berob o beshishshim, ayyen siman tm"z ubesiman tn"g ubesiman ts"z]:

Yisrael shehaya dar bebayit shel nokri verotzeh latzet mimmennu ladur bebayit acher beir zo o beacheret (y) vehannokri yikkanes lebeto qodem happesach, apillu hu yotze betok l' yom lipne happesach shekkebar chal alayv chobat habbiur, ap al pi ken en tzarik libdoq et bet hannokri shehu yotze mimmenna. Vaapillu yesh sham vadday chametz harbeh en tzarik lebaaro mishsham, shehare yukal leqayyem mitzvat biur beoto bayit sheyyadur bo bepesach. Vaapillu im yadur bebayit acher im adam acher veoto adam hu habbaal habbayit veyibdoq et beto vibaer hechametz beatzmo, mikkol maqom kevan sheoto baal habbayit yibdoq vibaer gam hechametz shennishtammesh zeh bebeto miyyom boo ad happesach — hare oto baal habbayit hu shelucho shel zeh libdoq ulebaer chametzo, ushelucho shel adam kemoto, vahare zeh keillu beatzmo bier chametzo. Veal chametzo shennishar bebet hannokri eno ober alayv kelum ap im yihyeh munnach sham kol yeme happesach, dekevan sheyyatza mibbet hannokri veazab sham chametzo velo netalo immo hare nityaesh mimmennu vehipqiro, shehare bevadday yittelennu hannokri leatzmo. Velo gazeru chakamim sheen bittul vehepqer moil lechametz, ella keshehechametz leachar shehipqiro hu munnach bepesach bigbul hamyuchad leyisrael zeh baal hechametz, o bigbul hamyuchad leyisreelim acherim, o apillu bigbul hamyuchad lenokri ella sheen hannokri yodea shehipqiro hayyisrael velo yittelennu leatzmo, abal keshehaddabar yadua shehannokri yittelennu leatzmo kesheyyimtzaennu bigbulo*[ap im keshehiggia happesach adayin lo metzao hannokri, o shemmetzao velo netalo adayin, kevan sheim haya rotzeh littelo haya notelo, ben shehaya notelo mechamat shehu yodea shennityaesh mimmennu hayyisrael vehipqiro, uben shehaya notelo mechamat shehu taqqip veallam]: — hare en leka hepqer gadol mizzeh. Velo gazeru chakamim ella shemmah shehaadam mapqir hechametz bepiv ubelibbo zeh en moil kelum, abal keshehechametz hu hepqer meelayv, kegon shehinnicho birshut harabbim, o shehinnicho birshut hamyuchedet lenokri beinyan shehu mupqar meelayv lenokri zeh baal hareshut, behepqer gadol kazeh lo gazeru chakamim im hipqiro qodem shaa shishshit beereb pesach, ayyen siman tm"h.

Abal im leachar sheyyotze mibbayit zeh dato leparesh layyam o latzet beshayyara qodem happesach beinyan shello yadur babbayit bepesach velo yukal leqayyem mitzvat "tashbitu seor mibbattekem", yesh omerim shehu chayyab libdoq bet hannokri shehu yotze mimmennu ulebaer hechametz mittoko im hu yotze mimmennu betok sheloshim yom veen yisrael acher niknas tachtayv ladur bebayit zeh shehu yotze mimmennu ella hannokri baal habbayit beatzmo o nokri acher (abal im yisrael acher niknas tachtayv — haacharon chayyab libdoq ulebaer chametzo shel rishon, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tl"z ayyen sham). Ap al pi shelleachar bediqato yikkanes hannokri letoko veyaknis bo chametz kol yeme happesach — en bekak kelum, sheen hayyisrael muzhar shello yihyeh chametz bebatte hannokrim bepesach, veen hayyisrael bodeq umebaer hechametz mibbayit zeh shehu yotze mimmennu ella kede leqayyem mitzvat "tashbitu seor mibbattekem", shekkebar nitchayyeb bah mishshehiggia l' yom shellipne happesach im lo yukal leqayyemah kesheyyaggia happesach, shekkol l' yom ellu chayyab hu lehizzaher betzorke happesach, dehaynu shekkol mitzva mimmitzvot happesach shello yukal leqayyemah kesheyyaggia zemannah veepshar lo leqayyemah betok l' yom ellu — chayyab hu leqayyemah middibre soperim. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik lebodqo kelal, vaapillu yesh sham chametz vadday harbeh — eno zaquq lo, sheap shehiggiu l' yom lo chala alayv mitzvat "tashbitu vego'", kevan sheyyihyeh patur mimmenna kesheyyaggia happesach velo yadur babbayit, shemmitzvat "tashbitu" enah chobat haggup sheyyitchayyeb adam lihyot lo bayit lebaer hechametz mittoko, ella im yesh lo bayit ubetoko chametz yesh alayv mitzvat "tashbitu", veim en lo bayit en alayv mitzva kelal. Veap im betok l' yom yesh lo bayit ubetoko chametz veyadua lo shekkesheyyaggia happesach lo yihyeh lo — eno mechuyyab apillu middibre soperim lebaer hechametz mibbeto qodem zeman shettiqqenu chakamim, kevan shekkesheyyaggia happesach lo yihyeh alayv mitzvat "tashbitu" kelal. Veim yihyeh lo az chametz belo bayit — yebaarennu az kemitzvato. (Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehaqel kassebara haacharona. Umi sherotzeh lehachamir — yachamir al atzmo, abal lo yoreh ken laacherim):

Vekol zeh (ya) keshehannokri niknas letoko qodem happesach, shekkeshenniknas hannokri lebeto naasa chametzo shel yisrael hammunnach sham hepqer meelayv lenokri zeh, shekkesheyyirtzeh littelo yittelennu. Abal im lo yikkanes letoko ad leachar happesach o ad tok happesach o ad shettaggia shaa shishshit beereb pesach, sheaz ap im naasa hechametz hepqer lenokri zeh biknisato lebeto — en zeh moil, dekevan shekkebar higgia shaa shishshit qodem shennaasa hepqer meelayv hare kebar nitchayyeb chametz zeh bebiur min haolam legamre, veen hepqer moil lo od, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h. Lepikak, chayyab hayyisrael libdoq bet hannokri shehu yotze mimmennu ap otan chadarim sheen tzerikim bediqa ki im middibre soperim, apillu im yadur bebayit bappesach beir zo o beir acheret, sheap sheyyukal leqayyem sham mitzvat "tashbitu", mikkol maqom im lo yibdoq umebaer hechametz mibbayit zeh shehu yotze mimmennu — yaabor alayv bepesach be"bal yimmatze" middibre soperim, sheggazeru shemmah shehaadam mebattel umapqir hechametz bepiv ubelibbo en moil kelum.*[Veematay yibdeqem? Im yotze ladur bebayit beir acheret, o shehu meparesh layyam, o yotze beshayyara — chayyab lebodqah ballayla shellipne yetziato mibbet hannokri im hu yotze mimmenna betok l' yom, sheaz chal alayv chobat biur. Veim hu niknas bebayit ladur beir zo, apillu hu yotze mibbet hannokri qodem l' yom — hare hu chayyab lebodqah beshaa shehu chayyab libdoq beto sheyyadur bo bappesach, dehaynu belel y"d, kede shello yaabor al hechametz shebbetokah be"bal yimmatze" middibre soperim]:
Kol sheloshim yom lipne happesach tob lizzaher uleayyen bekol dabar sheoseh shello yishshaer dabuq bo chametz beopen shello yukal lahasiro benaqel kesheyyaggia ereb pesach.
